{{2020–21 CAA men's basketball standings}}
The '''2020–21 James Madison Dukes men's basketball team''' represented [[James Madison University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Dukes, led by first-year head coach [[Mark Byington]], played their home games at the newly opened [[Atlantic Union Bank Center]]<ref>{{Cite news |last=Craft |first=Ben |date=November 11, 2020 |title=Dukes' new digs: JMU's new Atlantic Union Bank Center 'sets us apart' |url=https://newsvirginian.com/sports/dukes-new-digs-jmus-new-atlantic-union-bank-center-sets-us-apart/article_e84f20f0-2473-11eb-a302-7339d60e38a7.html |access-date=January 18, 2021 |work=The News Virginian |language=en}}</ref> in [[Harrisonburg, Virginia]] as members of the [[Colonial Athletic Association]] (CAA). In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they finished the season 13–7, 8–2 in [[2020–21 Colonial Athletic Association men's basketball season|CAA play]], to earn a share of the regular-season championship. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 CAA men's basketball tournament|CAA tournament]] to [[2020–21 Elon Phoenix men's basketball team|Elon]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-03-07 |title=JMU Ousted by Elon 72-71 in CAA Tournament |url=https://jmusports.com/news/2021/3/7/mens-basketball-jmu-ousted-by-elon-72-71-in-caa-tournament.aspx |access-date=2025-03-18 |website=James Madison University Athletics |language=en}}</ref>

Byington was named the CAA Coach of the Year while guard [[Matt Lewis (basketball)|Matt Lewis]] was named the CAA Player of the Year.

==Previous season==
The [[2019–20 James Madison Dukes men's basketball team|Dukes]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 9–21, 2–16 in CAA play, to finish in last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 CAA men's basketball tournament|CAA tournament]] to [[2019–20 Elon Phoenix men's basketball team|Elon]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=March 7, 2020 |title=JMU men's basketball's season ends in CAA tourney first round |url=https://www.whsv.com/content/sports/JMU-mens-basketballs-season-ends-in-CAA-tourney-first-round-568600701.html |access-date=January 18, 2021 |work=WHSV |language=en}}</ref>

On March 9, 2020, the school announced that head coach [[Louis Rowe (basketball)|Louis Rowe]] would not return as head coach for the Dukes.<ref>{{Cite news |date=March 9, 2020 |title=James Madison Mutually Parts with Louis Rowe, Opens Search for Men's Basketball Head Coach |url=https://jmusports.com/news/2020/3/9/james-madison-mutually-parts-with-louis-rowe-opens-search-for-mens-basketball-head-coach.aspx |access-date=January 18, 2021 |work=James Madison University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> A few weeks later, the school named [[2019–20 Georgia Southern Eagles men's basketball team|Georgia Southern]] head coach Mark Byington the Dukes' new head coach.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=March 20, 2020 |title=James Madison hires Mark Byington from Georgia Southern |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28932992 |access-date=January 18, 2021 |work=ESPN |language=en}}</ref>

== Offseason ==
Guard Matt Lewis opted to test the waters in the [[2020 NBA draft]]; however, he ultimately returned to the Dukes for his senior season.<ref>{{cite web |last=Fawcett |first=Dave |date=November 25, 2020 |title=After flirting with the NBA, Woodbridge resident, O'Connell graduate Matt Lewis returns as JMU's leader |url=https://www.insidenova.com/sports/prince_william/after-flirting-with-the-nba-woodbridge-resident-oconnell-graduate-matt-lewis-returns-as-jmus-leader/article_94d4e0ac-2d99-11eb-84f6-7f4346cae3a6.html |access-date=February 24, 2021 |work=Inside NOVA}}</ref>

== Preseason ==
In the preseason CAA poll, the Dukes were picked to finish ninth while Matt Lewis was chosen the preseason CAA Player of the Year.<ref>{{cite web|first=John|last=O'Connor|title=JMU's Matt Lewis earns CAA preseason hoops honor; Dukes, Tribe picked low|url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/james-madison/jmus-matt-lewis-earns-caa-preseason-hoops-honor-dukes-tribe-picked-low/article_867563fd-0536-573c-8966-b4f20b0ce902.html|work=whsv.com|date=November 11, 2020|access-date=February 24, 2021}}</ref>
